description: Commission of Elections - The appointed Returning Officer for Badulla Administrative District by Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 2045/53 of 17.11.2017 has left the country and has appointed Mr. P. S. Pathirana until further notice
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically concerns the appointment of a Returning Officer for Local Authorities elections in the Badulla Administrative District. The content is directly related to electoral processes and administration under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, falling clearly within the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral commission appointments and decisions.
